lastCompletedStory.title: Ignore the repo-local scratch root on all three sides

nextStoryContext: The scratch root `.cam-test-tmp/` is now ignored identically in .gitignore and templates/.gitignore (byte-identical rule line `.cam-test-tmp/`), and the embedded copy (src/vendor/_generated.ts) was regenerated via `bun run embed-vendor` and committed so `embed-vendor:check` stays clean. All 7 acceptance-criteria oracles verified green (AC1-AC2 file-assert, AC3 pinning-guard test, AC4 embed-vendor:check, AC5 typecheck, AC6 bun test, AC7 check:all). Any future story that writes into `.cam-test-tmp/` during a test run is now safe against dirtying the working tree on all three sides (repo, template, embedded copy).
